# Test corpus

`corpus.json` is a pinned snapshot of `developers/**/*.mdx`, `snippets/**/*.mdx` and `docs.json`
from https://github.com/discord/discord-api-docs at commit
`9d2128bb8301e7d9f239ff259f2ee41cf4d73c70` (branch `main` at fetch time).

Regenerate with `npx tsx scripts/fetch-corpus.ts` (optional `GITHUB_FETCH_TOKEN`).

Content: Discord Developer Documentation, CC-BY-SA 4.0. Not affiliated with Discord.
